_note: Economy baggage rules on flights between India and other countries (baggage/<slug>.html and baggage/international.html). Checked against each airline's own website. Re-check every ~3 months and bump 'checked'.

airlines.name: Emirates

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers can take one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 22 cm. When you board in India, only one piece is allowed, and its length, width and height together must not be more than 115 cm. Emirates doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: No separate laptop bag or handbag is listed for Economy from India: it's one piece only. Reasonable duty-free shopping is allowed on top

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg to 35 kg, depending on your fare
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: you can split the total into as many bags as you like. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag's length, width and height together should be no more than 203 cm.
airlines.infant: An infant ticket includes up to 10 kg of checked baggage, one 5 kg handbag for baby things, and a fully folding stroller or carrycot.
notes: Round bags, odd-shaped parcels, bags with loose straps and bags without a flat side don't travel well on the belt. Emirates asks you to repack them in a cardboard box.

Power banks: since 1 October 2025 you can't use or charge a power bank on board. You may carry one under 100 Wh in your cabin bag, kept in the seat pocket or under the seat, never in the overhead bin. Power banks aren't allowed in checked bags.
Zamzam water: Haj and Umrah pilgrims whose trip includes Madinah or Jeddah may carry up to 5 litres in a sealed container, on top of their checked allowance.
Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE Ministry of Health before you travel. Carry the prescription and no more than 3 months' supply.
Smart bags are allowed only if the battery can be removed.

sources.label: Power bank rules now in full effect

airlines.name: Qatar Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Every Economy fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 50 x 37 x 25 cm, smaller than most Indian 55 cm trolleys. Your laptop must fit in it: a separate laptop bag counts as your cabin bag. Qatar Airways doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: Small extras are allowed on top: a small purse or briefcase, a coat, an umbrella, a small camera, some reading and duty-free bought that day. A separate laptop bag is not extra

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg to 35 kg, depending on your fare
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: any number of bags within your total. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag can be up to 300 cm in total (length + width + height). Qatar Airways says exceptions apply on some routes, so check your ticket.
airlines.infant: Infants get their own 10 kg checked allowance and a free stroller or carrycot, but no cabin bag of their own.
notes: Qatar Airways won't accept round or odd-shaped items, bags tied with rope or string, items wrapped in blankets or bags with loose straps. Carefully wrapped and sealed boxes within the limits are fine.

Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't charge a power bank on board. You may use one to charge a phone at quiet times of the flight, only while you keep it in your hand, not in a bag or overhead bin.
Zamzam water: up to 5 litres in approved bottles, only for Hajj or Umrah pilgrims flying from Jeddah, Madinah or Taif (from Qatar Airways' travel agent notice of February 2026).
Spare batteries go in your cabin bag only. Devices in checked bags must be fully switched off, not in sleep mode.

sources.label: Travel planning for infants and children
Travel Advisory: Carriage of Zamzam Water

airlines.name: Etihad Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy guests on every fare, including Basic, get one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 56 x 36 x 23 cm. Etihad says laptops, purses and documents must go inside your cabin bag. It doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: No separate personal item is confirmed for Economy: laptops and purses go inside your cabin bag

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic; 25 kg to 40 kg on other fares
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: any number of bags within your total. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg. Extra baggage is much cheaper if you buy it online before you fly.
airlines.infant: Infants (not on Basic fares) get 10 kg of checked baggage, one 5 kg cabin piece and a free pushchair, carrycot or car seat.
notes: Power banks: only one, up to 100 Wh, with the rating marked. You can't use it on board, including to charge a phone. Keep it switched off, under the seat or in the seat pocket.
On flights to and from India, the MOBIKINS MK-PB-04 power bank is banned in all bags.
Satellite phones and GPS devices (such as Garmin) need permission from India's Department of Telecommunications to be taken to or from India.
Strong-smelling fruit such as jackfruit and durian isn't allowed on Etihad flights.

Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres free, sealed in a plastic container inside a cardboard box sold at the airport. From Jeddah you need an Umrah or Haj visa. Only 100 ml is allowed in the cabin.

sources.label: What is included in Economy fares

airlines.name: flydubai

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Every fare, including Lite, includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 20 cm. flydubai checks the size and weight of all hand baggage at the gate, and charges for each item over the limit. It doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item as part of your hand baggage: a laptop bag, small handbag or satchel up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm that fits under the seat, plus one duty-free bag

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Lite; 20 kg on Value and 30 kg on Flex
airlines.checkin_note: Up to 3 bags within your total. Each bag must weigh less than 32 kg and be no more than 203 cm in total. flydubai says allowances may vary by route, so check your ticket.
airlines.infant: If your fare includes baggage, an infant gets 5 kg of hand baggage and 10 kg of checked baggage, plus a folding stroller to the gate.
notes: Bags must have at least one flat side and no loose straps. Odd-shaped items must be packed in a box, and items must not be strapped together.
Don't put money, jewellery, gold or important documents in checked bags. If your cabin bag is sent to the hold at the gate, take these out first, along with medicines and power banks.
Power banks: one only, up to 100 Wh, in hand baggage. You can't use or charge it during the flight.
Zamzam water: from Jeddah, Madinah, Taif or Yanbu, up to 5 litres free as checked baggage, sealed in approved packaging.
Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE health ministry before you travel.

airlines.name: Air Arabia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, plus a 3 kg personal item
cabin.detail: Every fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 40 x 20 cm, plus one personal item up to 3 kg. Duty-free shopping must fit within the combined 10 kg, and bags over the limit at the gate may be charged.

personal.summary: One personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack, up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm and 3 kg

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic; 20–30 kg on Value and 30–40 kg on Ultimate
airlines.checkin_note: Each bag must weigh no more than 32 kg and measure no more than 158 cm in total. A 20 kg allowance is one bag; 30 and 40 kg can be split into up to 2 bags. Air Arabia doesn't explain which of its "20/30" amounts applies to which route, so check your booking. Extra baggage is cheaper if you book it at least 12 hours before departure.
airlines.infant: With an infant under 2 you may carry one extra 3 kg bag for baby things. No checked allowance for infants is listed.
notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only, not in the overhead bin. You can't use or charge them on board.
Zamzam water: passengers flying from Saudi Arabia may carry one 5-litre bottle free as checked baggage, bought from approved outlets at the airport.
These rules cover Air Arabia's flights to and from the UAE, including Air Arabia Abu Dhabi.

airlines.name: Saudia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Guest Class (economy) passengers may carry one hand bag or briefcase up to 7 kg and 56 x 45 x 25 cm. It must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat, and gets a cabin baggage tag. Saudia doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item on top, such as a coat, a women's handbag, a laptop or a camera. No size limit is given

checkin.fare: Guest Saver, Basic, Semi Flex and Flex
checkin.allowance: Shown only when you book; Saudia doesn't publish it by fare
Up to 23 kg and 158 cm in total; you can pay to raise one bag to 32 kg

airlines.checkin_summary: Depends on your fare and route, shown when you book; each economy bag up to 23 kg
airlines.checkin_note: Saudia's FAQ says the free allowance depends on your fare, route and class, and is shown on your booking. Each economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm in total. You can pay online to raise a bag to 32 kg; anything heavier, or over 300 cm, must go as cargo.
airlines.infant: Saudia's current pages don't list a checked allowance for infants. Strollers are checked free.
notes: Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres, only as a separate checked item, never inside your suitcase. It's free for everyone leaving Madinah; from other Saudi airports it counts within your allowance.
Power banks: up to two, in your cabin bag only. You can't recharge them on board or use them to charge other devices.

When we checked (3 Nov 2026), Saudia's site said flights to and from Riyadh were operating through Al Qassim or Dammam, with a Saudia bus to Riyadh, and that you must collect your checked bags before the bus. Check Saudia's travel updates before you fly.
Extra baggage bought on saudia.com or the app can be up to 30% cheaper than at the airport.

sources.label: Saudia extra baggage, baggage upgrade and notes

airlines.name: Oman Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy guests get one cabin bag up to 7 kg, with length, width and height adding up to no more than 115 cm. Oman Air doesn't give separate side limits, or say whether wheels and handles count.

personal.summary: Small extras are free on top: a handbag or purse, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading material, a laptop in a small bag and a mobile phone

checkin.allowance: 20 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
30 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
40 kg to or from the listed Indian cities

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg on Super Saver, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Flex to and from India
airlines.checkin_note: These higher allowances apply to tickets to or from Mumbai, Kozhikode, Kochi, Delhi, Goa (Mopa), Hyderabad, Lucknow, Chennai, Bengaluru and Thiruvananthapuram. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and Oman Air says heavier bags won't be accepted. Each bag can be up to 158 cm in total.
airlines.infant: An adult with an infant gets 10 kg of extra checked weight on all fares except Economy Saver. Infant carriers, cots and strollers go free.
notes: In April 2026 Oman Air raised its India allowances: Super Saver now includes 20 kg, where it used to be cabin bag only.

Power banks: cabin bag only, never checked in. Don't use or charge them during the flight, and keep them under the seat or in the seat pocket. Power banks without a visible capacity label are refused.
Pack your things in a suitcase or similar container. Oman Air may refuse bags it thinks are badly packed.

airlines.name: Gulf Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 6 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may carry one bag or briefcase up to 6 kg and 45 x 40 x 30 cm, according to the baggage calculator on gulfair.com. That's lighter and shorter than most airlines allow, so many 55 cm trolleys won't qualify. Cabin bags are weighed and tagged at check-in.

personal.summary: Free extras on top: a handbag or purse, a laptop, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading matter and infant food for the flight

airlines.checkin_summary: 30 kg on Light, 35 kg on Smart and 40 kg on Flex between India and Bahrain
airlines.checkin_note: These India allowances, from Gulf Air's baggage calculator, cover flights between Bahrain and Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Thiruvananthapuram, Goa and Kochi in both directions; other routes get 5 kg less. You can split your allowance into up to 5 bags, but no bag may weigh more than 32 kg or measure more than 158 cm in total.
airlines.infant: One checked piece up to 10 kg, a free folding stroller and car seat, and one 3 kg cabin bag.
notes: Gulf Air doesn't accept odd-shaped bags, bags wrapped in blankets or cloth, round bags without a flat side, woven sacks or plastic bags, or bags with long loose straps. Suitcases and cardboard boxes within the size limit are fine, and can be plastic-wrapped at the airport.
Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh. Don't charge them from the seat or use them to charge other devices during the flight.
Prepaid extra baggage is cheaper than at the airport and is sold in 5 kg steps.

airlines.name: Kuwait Airways

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 56 x 46 x 25 cm. Extra items are weighed with your bags and may be charged. Kuwait Airways doesn't say whether wheels and handles count.

personal.summary: One extra item: a handbag, briefcase, coat, umbrella, small camera, walking stick, or one duty-free item bought that day

airlines.checkin_summary: 2 x 23 kg on Economy, 1 x 32 kg on Economy Saver, none on Zero Bag
airlines.checkin_note: Kuwait Airways uses pieces, not total weight: on Economy you get two bags of up to 23 kg each. No single piece may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag can be up to 158 cm in total. Check your fare: Economy Zero Bag includes no checked bag on India routes.
airlines.infant: One piece up to 10 kg and 115 cm in total. Infants can't buy extra baggage.
notes: Zamzam water: passengers starting their trip at a Saudi airport may carry one 5-litre Zamzam piece within their free allowance, properly packed and tagged.
Pack your things in a suitcase or suitable container. Money, jewellery and valuables are at your own risk in checked bags, so carry them with you.

airlines.name: Singapore Airlines

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, with length, width and height adding up to no more than 115 cm. Bags that are too big are taken at check-in or the gate and put in the hold.

personal.summary: One extra item free: a handbag, camera bag, document bag or laptop bag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, a coat, an umbrella, or a small amount of duty-free

airlines.checkin_summary: 25 kg on Lite and Value, 30 kg on Standard and Flexi
airlines.checkin_note: India flights use the weight concept: you can check several bags as long as the total is within your allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg; heavier bags must be repacked.
airlines.infant: Up to 10 kg checked, plus a folding stroller and a carrycot or car seat.
notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't use or charge them at any time during the flight.
Smart bags whose battery can't be removed are refused.
Durians aren't allowed in any baggage, and strong-smelling food may be refused.

airlines.name: IndiGo (international)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, no bigger than 55 x 35 x 25 cm and 115 cm in total. IndiGo says this includes the wheels and handles. If the overhead bins are full, your bag may be checked in.

personal.summary: One personal item up to 3 kg, such as a ladies' purse or a small laptop bag

checkin.fare: Saver, Flexi Plus and other regular fares
checkin.allowance: 30 kg to and from the Gulf; 30 kg to Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta and Vietnam; 20 kg to Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi and Bali
35 kg on most Gulf routes and to Singapore and Kuala Lumpur; 25 kg to Bangkok, Phuket, Krabi and Bali
No free checked bag (you can buy one)

airlines.checkin_summary: 30 kg to the Gulf and Singapore, 20 kg to Bangkok and Bali, in up to 2 bags
airlines.checkin_note: The allowance is per person, in up to 2 bags; a third bag costs extra. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, even if you pay for excess, and each bag must be within 158 cm in total. Prepaid extra baggage, bought online up to 2 hours before an international flight, is much cheaper than at the airport.
airlines.infant: No checked allowance for infants on international flights. One 7 kg hand bag and one stroller per infant are free.
notes: Zamzam water: on flights from Jeddah and Madinah to India, it must fit within your 30 kg allowance.
India–Kuwait: your 30 kg can include a well-packed cardboard box within 158 cm.
Power banks and spare batteries go in your cabin bag only. You can't use or charge them during the flight.
You can carry up to 5 litres of alcohol (24–70%, in shop packaging) in checked baggage.

sources.label: IndiGo FAQ: baggage allowance by fare and route

airlines.name: Air India (international)

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy allows one cabin bag up to 7 kg, no bigger than 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 115 cm in total. On international flights you can pay to carry a cabin bag up to 12 kg; anything heavier must be checked in.

personal.summary: One small personal item up to 3 kg that fits under the seat, such as a handbag, camera bag or laptop bag up to 40 x 30 x 20 cm

airlines.checkin_summary: 25 kg on Value, 30 kg on Classic and 35 kg on Flex to the Gulf and South-East Asia
airlines.checkin_note: These allowances cover flights between India and the Gulf (including Saudi Arabia) and South-East Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines and Hong Kong), in both directions. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag must be within 158 cm in total. They apply only to flights run by Air India itself, not Air India Express.
airlines.infant: Up to 10 kg checked in Economy, plus a folding stroller, carrycot or car seat.
notes: Air India lists Gulf airport rules: Bahrain may reject round bags and bundles tied with rope; Muscat charges extra for bags without a flat side, tied with rope or wrapped in a blanket; Sharjah needs at least one flat side and no ropes; Dubai asks you to pack rope-tied items and plastic bags in boxes.
Zamzam water can't go inside your checked bag from Saudi airports. Only Hajj and Umrah visa holders may carry one official 5-litre bottle.
Power banks: cabin bag only, never checked, and not in the overhead bin.
